title: Unique identifier linking
description: The system may link data provided by users during face authentication enrollment through unique identifiers, which can lead to privacy concerns if these identifiers are misused or inadequately protected.

title: Data type sensitivity
description: The system may collect and process highly sensitive personal data (like biometric data) without strict necessity, causing potential risks of data exposure and misuse.

title: GDPR-related noncompliance
description: If the system does not provide adequate controls for data subjects regarding their rights, it may violate GDPR requirements, leading to legal consequences.

title: Linking through identifiers
description: The video feed from the camera may contain identifiable biometric data that can link individuals through the identifiers provided by their faces.

title: Identifiable information
description: The video feed includes identifiable information as it contains visual data that can uniquely identify individuals.

title: Data type sensitivity
description: The video feed could include highly sensitive types of personal data (e.g., biometric data) that should only be collected and processed when strictly necessary.

title: Unawareness of processing
description: Individuals may be unaware that their biometric data is being collected through video feeds, leading to privacy concerns.

title: Violation of data minimization principle
description: The collection of video data may violate the data minimization principle by capturing more personal data than functionally required for face authentication.

title: Unique identifier linking
description: The face authentication system may use unique identifiers which might link personal data to individuals, resulting in potential privacy threats.

title: Identifier processing
description: The system processes unique identifiers related to the data subjects, which could lead to identification risks.

title: High granularity of data disclosed
description: The process may disclose personal data with a level of granularity that exceeds functional requirements, constituting a data disclosure risk.

title: Violation of data minimization principle
description: The system may process more personal data than is necessary for the authentication function, violating the data minimization principle.

title: Linking through combination
description: Data flowing from the appropriateness check to the face authentication enrollment system may allow for linking through combinations of attributes that can lead to the identification of individuals.

title: Pseudonym identification
description: The appropriateness check may utilize unique references to the identity of the data subject, potentially leading to identifiable information being processed in the context of user authentication.

title: Data type sensitivity
description: If sensitive data types are being processed while checking appropriateness, more sensitive data types than necessary could be collected, which raises privacy concerns.

title: Violation of data minimization principle
description: The appropriateness check may involve processing more personal data than is required, violating the principle of data minimization in data processing.

title: Unawareness as data subject
description: Data subjects may be unaware of the processing involved in the appropriateness check, leading to a lack of transparency regarding their personal data.

title: Linking through a unique identifier
description: Features being extracted from data may include unique identifiers that can be linked back to the individuals, potentially leading to identifiability.

title: Processing of identified data
description: The feature extraction process may involve personal data that contains unique references to the identity of the data subject, leading to potential identifiability.

title: Data type sensitivity
description: The features being processed may include sensitive data types that are not strictly required for the functionality, raising concerns about unnecessary data use.

title: Invalid consent for data processing
description: There may be a risk that personal data is collected and processed without valid consent, especially in the context of ML processes.

title: Unawareness of processing by data subjects
description: Data subjects may be unaware that their data is being utilized for feature extraction in ML models, compromising their ability to provide informed consent.

title: Linked Data Issue
description: Facial features can link the biometric data to individuals, creating privacy risks due to identifiable data being used without consent.

title: Identifiable Information Processing
description: Processing of biometric data can directly lead to identification of individuals, raising privacy concerns.

title: Data Type Sensitivity
description: Facial data is considered highly sensitive and should only be collected when strictly necessary, which may not be the case in this flow.

title: Unnecessary Processing of Data
description: The system may be processing biometric data extensively beyond what is strictly necessary for enrollment, posing privacy risks.

title: GDPR-related Noncompliance
description: The system may violate data protection principles by not adhering to GDPR guidelines for processing biometric data.
